name: What is the typical process for installing energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for installing energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your existing windows. Once you select your new windows, they are ordered and manufactured. Upon arrival, our team will protect your home's interior and exterior. Old windows are carefully removed, and the new energy-efficient units are installed, ensuring proper sealing and insulation. We then trim and finish the interior and exterior, clean the work area thoroughly, and conduct a final walk-through with you to ensure satisfaction. The entire process aims for minimal disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves consultation, measurement, ordering, removal of old windows, installation of new units, sealing, finishing, and a final cleanup and inspection.
